xna-type.name: Achievement
xna-type.summary: Describes a single achievement, including the achievement name, description, picture, and whether it has been achieved by the currently signed in gamer.
xna-type.remarks: Warning This class and all related methods and properties only retrieve a calculated result for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE Services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, the properties in this class will not return a calculated result, and related methods will report a NotSupportedException .

property.name: Description
property.summary: Gets the localized achievement description string.
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value.

property.name: DisplayBeforeEarned
property.summary: Gets whether this achievement should be displayed before it is earned.
property.value: true if this achievement should be displayed before it is earned; false otherwise.
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value.

property.name: EarnedDateTime
property.summary: Gets the date at which this achievement was earned.
property.value: The date at which this achievement was earned.
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value.

property.name: EarnedOnline
property.summary: Gets whether this achievement was earned while online.
property.value: true if this achievement was earned while online; false otherwise.
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value.

property.name: GamerScore
property.summary: Gets the amount of gamer score awarded for earning this achievement.
property.value: The amount of gamer score awarded for earning this achievement.
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value.

property.name: HowToEarn
property.summary: Gets the localized description of the steps necessary to earn the achievement.
property.value: The localized description of the steps necessary to earn the achievement.
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value.

property.name: IsEarned
property.summary: Gets whether the current player has earned this achievement.
property.value: true if the current player has earned this achievement; false otherwise.
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value.

property.name: Key
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value. Achievements can be looked up from the AchievementCollection by key, and the key is passed to the SignedInGamer.BeginAwardAchievement method.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Gets the localized achievement name string, for display to the user.
property.remarks: Warning This property retrieves a calculated result only for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, this property will return immediately with a predetermined default value.

method.name: GetPicture
method.summary: Gets the image associated with this achievement.

overload.summary: Gets the image associated with this achievement.
overload.returns: A stream containing the image data for this achievement.
overload.remarks: Warning This class and all related methods and properties only retrieve a calculated result for titles approved to access Xbox LIVE Services through the Xbox LIVE Registered Developer Program . For Xbox LIVE Indie games, the properties in this class will not return a calculated result, and related methods will report a NotSupportedException . Use FromStream to convert the stream to a Texture2D .
